full_prompt_en: A square eighteenth-century oil portrait presents a young gentleman seated against a deep brown interior. His upper body fills most of the frame, with the shoulders turned slightly to the right and his pale face angled back toward the left. A small, composed smile lifts his lips, while his gaze rests just outside the frame. Short powdered curls form a soft white halo around his head; individual loops at the temples break the otherwise smooth silhouette. He wears a warm brown coat with broad lapels over a muted deep green waistcoat, and a loose white cravat opens into ruffled folds at the throat. The coat sleeves and forearms settle low across the foreground, where the forms become less distinct. At the left edge, warm carved-looking furnishings emerge from shadow, but the setting is largely subdued. Behind him, the background is an uneven field of umber, brown-black, and faint golden light, without a sharp architectural boundary. Gentle illumination from the upper left brightens the forehead, cheek, and white fabric, then fades across the coat and into the dark surround. The face is smoothly modeled with small warm transitions, while the hair, cravat, and clothing retain visible, feathery brushwork. Edges around the lit face and neckline are relatively clear; the lower body and background dissolve together. A narrow range of cream, pale rose, muted olive green, tobacco brown, and dark umber gives the painting its quiet warmth. The upright figure remains the clear center, with a little breathing room above the head and broad dark masses balancing the light face and cravat. The portrait feels intimate and poised, its soft surface and subdued light carrying more attention than accessories or setting.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形十八世纪油画肖像在深棕色室内背景前呈现一位年轻绅士。他的上半身占据画面大部，双肩略向右转，浅色面容则回向左侧。嘴角带着轻微而克制的笑意，目光落在画外。短短的扑粉卷发在头周围形成柔软的白色光环；太阳穴旁的独立卷环打破其余平滑的轮廓。他穿暖棕色宽翻领外套，内搭低调深绿色背心，松软白色领巾在喉前展开成褶皱。外套袖子和前臂低低地安放于前景，形体在此变得较为含混。左边缘有暖色、仿佛雕刻过的家具从阴影中浮出，但场景大体被压低。身后背景是深褐、棕黑及淡金色光迹构成的不均匀色域，没有鲜明建筑边界。来自左上方的柔和光线照亮额头、面颊和白布，随后掠过外套，渐入深色环境。面容以细微温暖过渡平滑塑形，头发、领巾和衣料保留轻羽般可见笔触。受光面部与领口周围的边缘相对清晰；下半身和背景则互相溶合。奶油白、浅玫瑰色、低调橄榄绿、烟草棕及深褐构成狭窄色域，带来安静暖意。直立人物保持明确中心，头顶留有少许空间，宽阔深色块平衡明亮面容和领巾。这幅肖像亲近而端庄，柔软表面与含蓄光线比配饰或环境更引人注意。
style_prompt_en: A softly painted oil surface favors gentle tonal transitions over hard drawing. Creamy highlights gather within a warm field of tobacco brown, muted olive, pale rose, and deep umber. Fine feathery strokes soften lighter textured passages, while darker broad areas remain thinly described and atmospheric. Illumination enters from one upper side, bringing central rounded forms forward and allowing the perimeter to fade into shadow. The clearest edges cluster around the brightest focal area; contours elsewhere loosen and merge with the surrounding field. An upright central mass is held by broad dark balances on either side, with modest space above and a soft, low foreground. The whole treatment is poised, intimate, and restrained, with painterly warmth and quiet asymmetry.
style_prompt_zh: 柔和绘制的油画表面重视轻缓明度过渡，胜过坚硬勾线。奶油色亮部聚集在烟草棕、低调橄榄绿、浅玫瑰色及深褐色构成的暖色域中。细小羽状笔触让较亮的肌理段落变软，较暗的大块则保持简略、富有空气感。光线从一侧上方进入，使中央圆润形体前突，并让画面周缘淡入阴影。最清楚的边缘集中于最亮焦点，其余轮廓松开，与周围色域融合。直立中央形块由两侧宽阔深色保持平衡，上方留有适度空间，前景低矮柔和。整体处理端庄、亲近而克制，带有绘画性暖意与安静的不对称。
theme_en: A young gentleman with powdered curls in a brown coat and green waistcoat
theme_zh: 一位穿棕色外套与绿色背心、留扑粉卷发的年轻绅士
name: Thomas Gainsborough
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
